title: 4.5dev5-4.5beta3: Godot won't start
body: ### Tested versions - Godot works in `4.4.1-stable` and `earlier`. - Does not start on `4.5-dev5` and `later`. ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (NVIDIA; 30.0.14.7514) - AMD Phenom(tm) II X6 1055T Processor (6 threads) ### Issue description Console: ``` F:\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe>Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64_console.exe F:\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe> ``` There's no logs in %APPDATA%\Godot\ Event Viewer (Translated): ``` Faulting application name: Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe, version: 4.5.0.0, timestamp: 0x686bf210 Faulting module name: Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe, version: 4.5.0.0, timestamp: 0x686bf210 Exception code: 0xc000001d Fault offset: 0x000000000606c7f5 Faulting process ID: 0x1e04 Faulting application start time: 0x01dbf0d1b4362b0c Faulting application path: F:\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe Faulting module: F:\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe\Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe Report ID: 1163a729-c9f9-438e-9b82-0394d83c55dc Full name of the faulting package: Application ID associated with the faulting package: ``` ``` Cannot access the file for one of the following reasons: either there is a problem with the network connection, the file disk or storage with drivers installed on this computer, or the disk is missing. The Godot Engine program will be closed due to this error. Program: Godot Engine File: See the “Additional Data” section for the error code. User Action 1. Open the file again. The problem may be temporary and will correct itself when you run the program again. 2. If the file is still not being accessed and yet: - it is located on a network disk, the network administrator should verify that the network is working properly and that the server can be accessed; - it is on a removable disk, such as a floppy disk or CD-ROM, make sure the disk is fully inserted into the computer. 3. Check and restore the file system using the CHKDSK command. To run the CHKDSK command, click Start, Run, type “CMD” and click OK. At the command prompt, type the command “CHKDSK /F” and press the Enter key. 4. If the problem could not be fixed, restore the file from an archived copy. 5. Check to see if you can open other files on the same disk. If not, it is possible that the disk is damaged. If it is a hard disk, contact your system administrator or hardware manufacturer for assistance. Additional information Error value: 00000000 Disk type: 0 ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Download Godot `4.5dev1`-`4.5beta3` 2. Launch `Godot_v4.5-*_win64.exe` or `Godot_v4.5-*_win64_console.exe` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
